message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate the cost of a business class ticket for the first airport on the available list to the last airport on the same list, on the last day of October 2026. They also want the estimated total payable amount. We need to get the list of all airports, find the first and last, then get flight cost. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what does "estimated total payable amount" mean? Possibly the flight cost plus some additional fees? Or maybe just the flight cost? The user didn't specify insurance or anything else. So likely they want the flight cost. But "estimated total payable amount" might include taxes, fees, etc. The get_flight_cost function returns the cost in USD. That might be the total. So we can call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=last airport code, travel_date='2026-10-31', travel_class='business'.

We need to get the list of all airports first. Use list_all_airports. Then parse the result. Then call get_flight_cost.

We need to call the function.
